newsitem.title: MALTA: SOCCER-FIRST WORLD CUP MATCH SUCCESS FOR FAROE ISLANDS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIRST WORLD CUP MATCH SUCCESS FOR FAROE ISLANDS.

text.p: The Faroe Islands won their first World Cup match in their history on Wednesday, triumphing 2-1 away to fellow strugglers Malta.
The defeat left Malta rooted at the foot of European group six with no points from seven games. and plunged the island into its deepest ever soccer crisis.
The Faroes, victorious for the first time in six attempts in the group, move to three points thanks to a last minute winner from Tody Jonsson.
Malta dominated for long stretches but failed to build on an eighth minute goal from Stefan Sultana.
The game turned towards the Faroe Islands on the hour when Jonsson was floored in the penalty area and Ossur Hansen scored from the spot.
In a rousing finale, The Faroes hit the woodwork three minutes before time and Maltese striker Antoine Zahra was sent off for rough play in the last minute.
With virtually the last kick, Jonsson beat goalkeeper Mario Muscat with a powerful low drive to make a little piece of soccer history.

Malta: 1-Mario Muscat, 2-Lawrence Attard (Noel Turner 50), 3-Jeffrey Chetchuti, 4-Silvio Vella, 5-Darren Debono, 6-Ivan Zammit, 7-Gilbert Agius, 8-Nicky Saliba, 9-Stefan Sultana, 10-Joe Brincat, 11-Antoine Zahra.

Faroes: 1-Martin Knudsen, 2-Paul Ennigrad, 3-Kristian Hansen, 4-Oli Johannesen, 5-Henning Janskor, 6-Julian Johansen, 7-Mikkial Thomasen, 8-John Petersen (Jens Erik Rasmussen 55), 9-Ossur Hansen, 10-Alan Morkore, 11-Tody Jonsson.
